related_questions.question: Is First Federal Bank FDIC insured?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, First Federal Bank is FDIC insured. The FDIC (Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation) insures deposits at member banks, including First Federal, up to $250,000 per depositor, per insured bank, for each account ownership category. You can use the FDIC's Electronic Deposit Insurance Estimator (Ask Edie) to check the specific coverage for your deposits.
